description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called SwipeDeck, which provides a minimal swipeable card stack with like/dislike functionality. It includes a stateful widget that manages the current card index and triggers external callbacks on swipe actions.

classes.name: SwipeDeck
classes.description: A minimal swipe deck widget with like/dislike callbacks, displaying a stack of cards and managing swipe interactions.

classes.name: _SwipeDeckState
classes.description: The internal state class managing the card index and user interactions within SwipeDeck.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the SwipeDeck widget.

methods.name: _like
methods.description: Handles the 'like' action by invoking the callback and advancing to the next card.

methods.name: _dislike
methods.description: Handles the 'dislike' action by invoking the callback and advancing to the next card.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying the current card or a 'No more cards' message, along with like/dislike buttons.
